caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate lamp centered within a rectangular border on a beige background. The lamp consists of several distinct sections: the base is composed of three stepped layers, the bottommost being white with shaded gray accents, the middle section decorated with an intricate gold pattern, and the topmost part again in white. The main shaft of the lamp is an elongated, bulbous blue glass form adorned with white oval and circular highlights. Above this, a gold-colored fitting connects to a wide, round, and slightly flattened blue glass lampshade, which is similarly decorated with white floral and circular patterns. The lampshade is topped with a small gold element. The overall color palette consists mainly of deep blue, white, gold, and beige tones, with the lamp itself being the focal point and rendered in a realistic style.
title: Lamp
